Manila, get ready to experience 𝐉𝐀𝐂𝐊𝐒𝐎𝐍 𝐖𝐀𝐍𝐆: 𝐌𝐀𝐆𝐈𝐂 𝐌𝐀𝐍 𝟐 𝐖𝐎𝐑𝐋𝐃 𝐓𝐎𝐔𝐑 𝟐𝟎𝟐𝟓–𝟐𝟎𝟐𝟔 — a night of fire, art, and emotion that will set the Araneta Coliseum ablaze! 💥
